meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: A goal-like loop that decomposes work into systematic, evidence-bound ultrawork steps. Use when the user wants a goal loop or durable, checkpointed execution.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一个目标拆成可检查的执行步骤,中断后能从断点接着跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果任务步骤多、耗时长,中途容易断,需要留下进度并能续跑。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a goal into checkpointed steps that resume after interruption.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if work spans many steps and must pick up after interruptions.

howto.what: 它把目标拆成一串超细步骤,先注册目标、把每步同步进实时清单,并给每条成功标准配来自真实界面(终端、HTTP、浏览器等)的可观察证据;中断后先读回目标与记录再接着跑,不从零重来。
howto.when: 当你说 “ulw-loop” 或 “ulw”,或要求可长期断点续跑的目标循环、带证据的工作(如手动 QA)时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 帮我开一个目标循环,把这件事拆成一步步带证据的步骤
say.note: 先注册目标,再逐步执行并记录证据。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop status 看看现在的目标进度和检查点
say.note: 读回目标、ledger 与当前状态。

howto.what_en: It splits the goal into ultra-granular steps, keeps a live checklist, and ties each success criterion to real-surface evidence (terminal, HTTP, browser). Goals registered up front; after context loss it resumes from goals and ledger.
howto.when_en: Fires when you say “ulw-loop” or “ulw”, or ask for a goal loop, durable checkpointed execution, or evidence-led work such as manual QA.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to open a goal loop and split this into evidence-bound steps
say_en.note: Goals are registered first, then steps run with evidence.

say_en.text: Run ulw-loop and register the goal and success criteria via define-goal first
Check ulw-loop status for current goal progress and checkpoints
say_en.note: Reads back goals, ledger and current state.
